Asher new flyer

Meet ASHER! 🐾
Asher was found when he was just a tiny little baby, far too young to be out in the world on his own. Thankfully, he was given a chance—and look at him now. 🥹❤️
At about 3 months old, Asher is growing into one fantastic little pup!
🐶 Approximately 3 months old
🐾 Unknown mix — possibly a little German Shepherd in there!
💉 Up to date on shots
🥰 LOVES to cuddle
🌳 Loves being outdoors
🏡 Working on housetraining
❤️ All-around great puppy
